verdantia-ground: deep woodland loam, dense olive moss and dry oak leaf litter, fine earthy detail, no rocks
aetheria-ground: wind-packed ivory snow over pale slate, subtle blue-grey icy grains and thin frost
nexus-ground: charcoal synthetic desert dust and fine mineral grains, scarce teal flecks, no large objects
verdantia-road: warm irregular ochre sandstone pavers with worn edges and restrained soft moss in seams
aetheria-road: worn pale limestone flagstones with fine blue slate seams and sparse frost at the joints
nexus-road: flat worn graphite alloy panels, subtle industrial recessed joints and scuffed ceramic edges
verdantia-waterbank: pale alluvial silt, fine rounded dark pebbles and scattered low moss, gentle river bank sediment
aetheria-terrace: carved pale stone terrace blocks, thin gold mineral lines, frost in shadowed joints
nexus-yard: industrial ceramic ground slabs, dark matte metal seams and weathered amber service paint traces
verdantia-rock: layered slate outcrop stone with subtle moss and warm brown mineral bands, flat rock material
aetheria-rock: stratified blue-grey mountain slate cut by delicate pale ice bands, flat rock material
nexus-rock: dark fractured metalliferous badlands rock, muted purple oxides and fine turquoise mineral grains
verdantia-meadow: short dense muted green meadow grass mixed with fine clover, sparse ivory petals
aetheria-ice: blue-grey glacial ice sheet, faint pale fractures, matte softly diffused surface
nexus-waste: oxidized slag, small graphite grit and fine orange rust deposits, uneven mineral texture
